**Notes**

* The 2005 Parliamentary Constituencies Order created 59 Scottish seats that were used unchanged for the 2005, 2010, 2015 and 2019 general elections.  These were replaced only by the 2024 review.  (See *Scottish Westminster constituencies 2005 to 2024*.)  
* In 2019 the SNP won 48 of those 59 seats.  Because no boundary changes occurred between 2005 and 2019, every SNP‑winning seat was an unchanged (though sometimes renamed) constituency from the 2005 Order.  (See the “Winner” table on *2019 United Kingdom general election in Scotland*.)
